qualifier: with olfactory nerve and GnRH neuron migration
name: Hindbrain, cranial nerve and olfactory–GnRH neuron development
rationale: Members cover brainstem/pons maturation, trigeminal/facial/branchiomotor nerves and cranial ganglia, and unlike the spinal-cord, DRG or enteric confusables they add olfactory nerve development, GnRH neuron migration and fungiform papilla formation.

qualifier: vitamin D metabolism, PTH and FGF–Klotho
name: Vitamin D metabolism and endocrine control of bone mineralization
rationale: Members combine vitamin D synthesis/catabolism (CYP27B1, CYP24A1 defects), PTH and FGFR1c–Klotho signalling with bone mineralization regulation, whereas confusables centre on phosphate transporters, tooth mineralization or vitamin K.

name: Methionine–folate one-carbon cycle and selenium methylation
rationale: Members span methionine/SAM synthesis and salvage, folate/THF interconversion and their inherited defects, and uniquely include metabolism and methylation of ingested selenium compounds, absent from the cobalamin/vitamin, transsulfuration and glutathione confusables.

name: Eye, retinal vasculature and placental trophoblast development
rationale: Members are a composite of eye morphogenesis (lens, cornea, iris, RPE, retinal vessels, blood–retinal barrier) and placental trophoblast/decidual development, the trophoblast arm being what the purely ocular confusables lack.

name: Positive control of RNA polymerase II initiation and elongation
rationale: Members cover preinitiation complex assembly, promoter clearance, pausing and elongation complex formation with positive regulators, while confusables are dominated by HIV/Tat elongation and negative elongation control.

core: Vesicle targeting and tethering to Golgi
name: Rab GTPase regulation and vesicle tethering at Golgi
rationale: Members combine Rab GEF/GAP control, Rab geranylgeranylation and ARF signalling with vesicle targeting/tethering to the Golgi, distinct from confusables centred on COPI/COPII coats, Golgi structure or SNARE docking.

name: Actin-bundle protrusions: microvilli and hair-cell stereocilia
rationale: All members concern parallel actin bundles forming brush-border microvilli or cochlear stereocilia for mechanotransduction, unlike the inner-ear morphogenesis, vestibular or eye confusables.

name: Dolichol-pathway N-glycosylation and congenital disorders of glycosylation
rationale: Members cover GDP-mannose and dolichyl-phosphate sugar donor synthesis, lipid-linked oligosaccharide assembly, N-glycan processing and the corresponding CDGs, unlike the GPI-anchor and nucleotide-sugar confusables.

core: Cellular mechanosensing of shear and pressure
qualifier: PIEZO1, cell volume and membrane blebbing
name: PIEZO1 mechanosensing of shear, pressure and cell volume
rationale: Members are responses to fluid shear, mechanical load and hydrostatic pressure via PIEZO1 plus cell volume, blebbing and membrane repair, distinct from confusables on tight junctions, SRF targets or eNOS.

name: Pyrimidine deoxyribonucleotide synthesis and salvage toward dTTP
rationale: All members concern anabolic pyrimidine (deoxy)nucleoside/nucleotide formation and salvage to dTTP, whereas confusables are catabolic or de novo UMP/UTP synthesis.

qualifier: with glycine/glutamine conjugation of aromatic acids
name: Glycine, alanine and threonine metabolism with acyl-amino acid conjugation
rationale: Members cover glycine/glyoxylate, alanine and threonine metabolism and mitochondrial glycine/glutamine conjugation of benzoate, salicylate and phenylacetate, which the glutamate, proline or aromatic-amino-acid confusables lack.

name: Base excision repair gap-filling and mitochondrial DNA maintenance
rationale: Members are short- and long-patch BER gap-filling steps plus mitochondrial DNA repair/metabolism, a narrow subset distinct from broad DNA repair, editing or chromatin confusables.

qualifier: paracellular magnesium handling via tight junctions
name: Renal sodium–potassium transport and paracellular magnesium handling
rationale: Members regulate Na+/K+ transport in kidney together with magnesium transport and tight-junction paracellular permeability, the latter absent from the chloride cotransporter, osmotic and P-type ATPase confusables.

qualifier: common gamma-chain, IL-12 and IL-10 families
name: Common gamma-chain, IL-12 and IL-10 family interleukin signaling
rationale: Members are signalling by IL-2/7/9/15/21, IL-12/23/27/35, IL-10/20 and IL-3/5 with NK-cell regulation, whereas confusables are IL-6/gp130 family or TCR network signalling.

name: Reactive oxygen species detoxification and cellular redox homeostasis
rationale: All three members describe ROS detoxification and redox balance, distinct from confusables on ascorbate, selenium, metal responses or nitrosative stress.

name: Striated muscle myogenesis, regeneration and growth control
rationale: Members regulate skeletal myoblast differentiation/fusion, satellite-cell regeneration and cardiomyocyte proliferation, growth, hypertrophy and atrophy, unlike confusables on calcineurin/NFAT, extraocular muscle or sarcomere contraction.

qualifier: lung branching, pneumocytes, trachea and diaphragm
name: Respiratory tract development: lung branching, trachea and diaphragm
rationale: Members cover lung branching, mesenchyme, pneumocyte differentiation, trachea and diaphragm (plus palate and ductus closure), distinct from salivary/limb branching and surfactant confusables.

qualifier: DSCAM, sidekick, nectins and receptor tyrosine phosphatases
name: Neuronal adhesion and self-avoidance via DSCAM, sidekick, nectins
rationale: Members are homophilic/heterophilic neuronal adhesion (DSCAM, SDK, nectin, RPTP) and dendrite self-avoidance, whereas confusables centre on L1-family, neurofascin/paranodal or retinal differentiation.

name: Regulation of prostaglandin biosynthesis and secretion
rationale: All members regulate prostaglandin synthesis or arachidonate/prostaglandin release, whereas confusables are COX enzymology or prostanoid/leukotriene receptor signalling.

name: Nucleoside, nucleobase and nucleoside-analog drug membrane transport
rationale: Members are equilibrative nucleoside/purine transport and transport of nucleoside-analog drugs and xenobiotics, distinct from confusables on nucleotide interconversion, mitochondrial transport or thiopurine metabolism.

name: Proton-coupled peptide and histidine transmembrane transport
rationale: Members describe proton/oligopeptide cotransport of di/oligopeptides and histidine including vacuolar transport, unlike confusables on neutral/cationic amino acid transporters or histamine.

qualifier: p53 and DREAM repression of cell cycle genes
name: G2/M transition and its p53–DREAM transcriptional repression
rationale: Members cover G2 phase, cyclin B–CDK1/PLK/MASTL events and G2/M checkpoint plus p53/DREAM-mediated repression of cell cycle genes, distinct from G1/S, E2F proliferation, DNA-damage p53 and APC/C mitotic exit confusables.

core: Regulation of miRNA processing and turnover
qualifier: miRNA control of specific target translation
name: Regulation of miRNA processing, turnover and target-specific translation
rationale: Members regulate miRNA transcription, processing and degradation and miRNA control of particular mRNAs (CDH1, CDH11, PD-L1, NPAS4), whereas confusables are core RISC silencing and general mRNA decay.

qualifier: kinase-inhibitor resistance and hematopoietic STAT5 signaling
name: Oncogenic RTK mutants, kinase-inhibitor resistance and hematopoietic STAT5 signaling
rationale: Members are cancer mutants/fusions of KIT, FLT3, PDGFR, ALK, ERBB2, EGFR and FGFR with TKI resistance plus EPO/TPO/IL-3/G-CSF STAT5 signalling, distinct from wild-type RTK, MET or interleukin confusables.

qualifier: Notch/TSR O-fucose and O-glucose glycosylation and disorders
name: Glycosaminoglycan synthesis and Notch/TSR O-glycosylation, including disorders
rationale: Members cover CS/DS/HS/KS proteoglycan chain synthesis and linkage region with their genetic defects plus O-fucose/O-glucose glycosylation of Notch and TSR proteins, unlike N-glycan or sulfate-transporter/cartilage confusables.
